title: Figma Plugin Robustness - Test Brittleness & Parser Enhancement
overview: Fix brittle tests and enhance the Tailwind parser to handle advanced patterns. The registry integration phase (15 generators) is COMPLETE. This phase focuses on removing test brittleness and improving parser capabilities.

context.problem: 1) Some tests use hardcoded variant counts/names that break when components change. 2) Parser doesn't handle advanced Tailwind patterns (state variants, arbitrary values, opacity modifiers). 3) Some generators need tests added.
context.current_state: Registry integration COMPLETE (15/15 generators). Tests exist for 29/29 generators but some have brittle assertions. Parser handles basic patterns but misses hover:, focus:, w-[350px], bg-primary/70 patterns.
context.why_now: Registry integration is done - the dynamic parsing works. Now we need to: 1) Make tests resilient to component changes, 2) Extend parser for advanced patterns, 3) Add missing tests.

primary: Fix brittle tests - replace hardcoded variant counts with dynamic checks
Add tests for generators missing rigorous coverage
Enhance parser to handle state variants (hover:, focus:)
Enhance parser to handle arbitrary values (w-[350px])
Enhance parser to handle opacity modifiers (bg-primary/70)
metrics: All tests pass when new variants are added to components
Parser handles 90%+ of Tailwind patterns used in components
All generators have rigorous structural + snapshot tests
